## Summary

Describe the change and the hardware/problem it addresses.

## Provenance and licensing

- [ ] Existing SPDX and copyright notices are preserved.
- [ ] Any imported/adapted open-source material names its source, revision, and license.
- [ ] No proprietary firmware, vendor binaries/source, ACDB/tuning payloads, credentials, or unclear-redistribution material is included.
- [ ] I have read `LICENSING.md`.

## Kernel upstream readiness

- [ ] Kernel-bound commits I certify carry my own DCO `Signed-off-by:`.
- [ ] I did not invent another person's `Signed-off-by:` or other kernel trailer.
- [ ] The accepted result is reduced to a focused delta against an appropriate upstream base.
- [ ] Relevant build/checkpatch/schema checks were run, or exceptions are explained below.
- [ ] Hardware validation and rollback/recovery implications are described below.

## Validation

List the exact kernel/base, SP11 hardware, commands, and observed result.
